description_en: Invoke this API to authorize a license for a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定产品授权License
kebab_example: aliyun iot bind-license-product --iot-instance-id iot-23000 --license-code 480P --product-key a1BwAGV000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindLicenseProduct

parameters.description_en: The instance ID of the Enterprise instance. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
parameters.description_zh: 企业版实例的实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。
parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Enterprise instance. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console

parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en: The license type (audio and video specification). Valid values: **480P**, **720P**.
parameters.description_zh: License类型（音视频规格），可取值：**480P**、**720P**。
parameters.help_en: The license type (audio and video specification). Valid values: **480P**, **720P**
parameters.help_zh: License类型（音视频规格），可取值：**480P**、**720P**
parameters.name: license_code

parameters.description_en:
The ProductKey of the product to be authorized.

You can view the information of all products under the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) API.
parameters.description_zh:
待授权的产品的ProductKey。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用接口[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息。
